# Beast Coach

> Beast Coach is an online coaching business and set of free tools, run by Stefan Botha in Melbourne, Australia. It is at https://www.beastcoach.fit.

## About Stefan Botha

- Name: Stefan Botha. Founder of Beast Coach. Based in Melbourne, Australia.
- Has 24 years in product development.
- Lost 70kg, reached his goal in March 2026, and has kept it off since.
- Builds free tools people use (Beast Challenge, the calculator, the advent calendar, recipes) and improves them from user feedback.
- Profiles: Instagram https://www.instagram.com/stefanhealth_/ , LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/stefan-botha/ , TikTok https://www.tiktok.com/@beast_health_app

## What Beast Coach offers

Online 1:1 coaching, 12 weeks, prices in AUD:
- Basic: $2.50 AUD a week ($30 AUD per 12 weeks), self-guided, billed every 12 weeks.
- Essential: $110 AUD for 12 weeks.
- Core: $299 AUD for 12 weeks.
- The Beast: $699 AUD for 12 weeks.

Free tools: the Beast Challenge, a calculator, a 25 day advent health calendar, and recipes.

## Main pages

- [Home and coaching plans](https://www.beastcoach.fit/): online coaching, the plans and how they work.
- [About Stefan](https://www.beastcoach.fit/about): Stefan's story and the facts above.
- [Features](https://www.beastcoach.fit/features): what the Beast Coach app and portal do.
- [The Discipline Path](https://www.beastcoach.fit/discipline-path): an 8-step self-paced program.
- [Recipes](https://www.beastcoach.fit/recipes): public recipe teasers. Full recipes are free with sign-up.
- [Beast Challenge](https://www.beastcoach.fit/beast-challenge): a free 10,000 steps a day challenge with habit logging.
- [30-day challenge](https://www.beastcoach.fit/30-day-challenge): a free 30-day habit challenge.
- [Advent calendar](https://www.beastcoach.fit/advent): a 25 day health calendar, free.
- [Calculator](https://www.beastcoach.fit/calculator): BMI, calories and macros.
- [Walking study](https://www.beastcoach.fit/walking-study): what the walking study says about the cost of walking.
